svg.title: Human agent collaboration risk framework
svg.desc: Low risk routes to bounded autonomous assistance, medium risk to human-on-the-loop monitoring, high risk to human-in-the-loop approval, and critical risk to a human decision. Each path provides explanation, evidence, confidence, handoff, intervention, and audit.
svg.text: Human-agent collaboration matches oversight to risk
Explanation + evidence + confidence + handoff + intervention + audit
Agent autonomy is bounded, revocable, and never replaces accountable human authority
